title: Explicit pending return
requirement: WHEN a non-tail call is entered, the interpreter SHALL retain its pending caller computation in explicit frames.
expectedSource: spec text only; no expectation was derived from implementation behavior

scenarios.name: Factorial multiplication
scenarios.then: The pending multiplication by 3 remains represented until the callee returns.

expected.pending caller computation: at least three simultaneously pending frames at the deepest point of factorial(3), none at Halted

unasserted: identity of the specific pending multiplication-by-3 frame (frame contents are not decoded)
